title: Product Auditor
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Role Overview The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks. The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale. Key Responsibilities  Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.  Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity. Product Design & Control Assurance Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.  Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live. Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review) Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.  Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns. Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.  Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.  Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release. Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.  Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario. Settlement & Ledger Integrity Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.  Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides. Product Change & Configuration Integrity Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.  Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms. Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.  Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes. Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.  Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.  Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.  Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.  Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release. Reporting & Governance Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.  Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage. Required Knowledge & Skills  Technical Skills Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation API and integration literacy (Basic) End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets Audit & Risk Skills Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products. Control design logic and evaluation Root cause analysis Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc Interpersonal & Professional Skills Stakeholder engagement Professional scepticism and independence Risk-rated report writing Tools & Platforms SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL) AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets Claude / AI Tools Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline Experience: 3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment Certifications: CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics. Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context. title: Product Design Lead
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role: As a Product Design Lead, you will own the execution of our design vision, managing a small team of designers across multiple teams to prioritise initiatives, drive strategic projects, and foster a culture of excellence. Balancing leadership with hands-on design, you will ensure we deliver business-driven, user-centred solutions that elevate the user experience.This role requires strong leadership, UX/UI expertise, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to remove blockers, streamline workflows, and create scalable, accessible designs that align with both user and business needs. What you’ll do Lead and manage a small team of product designers, ensuring project prioritisation, team alignment, and timely execution of high-quality design work. Mentor and inspire your team, fostering a culture of feedback, learning, and innovation through regular critiques, coaching, and skill development. Manage project timelines, roadmaps, and design workflows, ensuring the team delivers high-quality work on schedule. Maintain a hands-on approach, contributing directly to key design projects while balancing leadership responsibilities. Partner with product managers, engineers, and executives to translate strategic goals into user-friendly design solutions. Advocate for user-centred design by leveraging qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, and behavioural insights to make informed design decisions. Ensure design consistency and scalability through the use of design systems and atomic design principles. Champion accessibility (a11y) and inclusive design, ensuring our products are usable by a diverse audience. Collaborate with analytics and product teams to measure the impact of design and optimise experiences based on data. What you need to succeed A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to lead design teams and deliver end-to-end product design solutions across platforms, backed by user research and measurable impact. Experience leading and developing design teams, fostering collaboration, mentorship, and performance-driven growth. Expertise in UX/UI principles, interaction design, and user research methodologies, with a proven track record of delivering results-driven digital products. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and advocate for design at all levels. Strategic mindset, with the ability to translate product goals into scalable, flexible, and user-centric design solutions. Experience managing design workflows, tools, and operational processes to improve team efficiency and output. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively balancing multiple priorities while maintaining design excellence. Experience in fintech or SaaS, with a strong understanding of financial products, compliance, security, and designing for trust. What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will influence design strategy and impact millions of users. Opportunities for career growth - mentorship, leadership development, and the ability to scale and shape a high-performing design team. Autonomy and influence - own design decisions, drive cross-functional collaboration, and define best practices. A high-performing and collaborative team - work alongside talented designers, engineers, and product managers in a culture that values design excellence. A culture of experimentation - we encourage bold ideas, rapid iteration, and data-driven design improvements. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture with support for professional development and engagement with the design community. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and UX case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes. Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations. Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

title: Regional Facilities Manager, North East
description: About Moniepoint In a nutshell, we power the dreams of businesses and their customers.Moniepoint Inc. is on a mission to deliver financial happiness to every African, everywhere, byproviding businesses, their employees, and their customers with simple financial tools. Since2019, we’ve become Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, processing over $17 billion monthlythrough our all-in-one digital financial services platform, serving 10 million businesses andindividuals. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint MFB and TeamApt Ltd., we provide seamlesspayments, banking, credit, and business management tools, handling the majority of POStransactions in Nigeria and standing strong as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech. What We Are Looking ForWe’re looking for dynamic and results-oriented Regional Facilities Managers to oversee themanagement of our facilities across designated regions in Nigeria. If you excel in projectexecution, workspace functionality, space planning, and can translate concepts intoactionable 2D/3D architectural drawings, we’d love to meet you. All successful candidates must demonstrate strong project management capabilities andpossess a valid HSE certification. These roles are essential to supporting our growinginfrastructure with compliant, well-designed, and efficient work environments. Role OverviewAs a Regional Facilities Manager at Moniepoint, you will manage the operations of multiplefacilities in your assigned region. Your responsibilities will span property acquisition, officedevelopment, health and safety compliance, project execution, space planning, vendoroversight, and facility maintenance. You will leverage your proficiency in architectural and 3D design to conceptualize and deliverworkspace layouts that align with Moniepoint’s operational and brand standards. This roledemands cross-functional collaboration, technical excellence, and the ability to delivercost-effective, scalable infrastructure solutions. Key ResponsibilitiesFacilities Operations and Management● Manage daily operations and maintenance of all Moniepoint facilities in the region,including offices, branches, and repair centers.● Ensure facilities comply with local regulations, health and safety standards, andcompany policies.● Implement preventive maintenance programs and monitor service delivery quality.● Oversee workspace functionality, safety, and operational standards.Space Planning and Design● Develop detailed 2D architectural plans and 3D renderings for new and existing facilities.● Utilize tools like AutoCAD, Revit, or SketchUp to optimize space usage and designlayouts.● Translate business requirements into functional, efficient, and brand-alignedworkspaces.● Review and update designs in collaboration with internal stakeholders.Property Acquisition and Lease Management● Lead the identification, negotiation, and acquisition of properties that meet businessneeds.● Support lease documentation, title verification, and legal review with relevantdepartments.● Manage office and employee relocation efforts, ensuring smooth transitions.Project Management and Workspace Coordination● Deliver end-to-end management of facility development and upgrade projects acrossmultiple locations.● Coordinate project timelines, design reviews, contractor engagement, and execution.● Ensure adherence to quality standards, budgets, and deadlines.● Provide post-project support including snag list closure and handover documentation.Vendor and Contractor Management● Select, onboard, and oversee third-party vendors for construction, maintenance, andsupport services.● Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, drive compliance, and manage performancereviews.● Ensure timely issue resolution and maintain relationships with key service providers.Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance● Enforce strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations acrossall facilities.● Implement safety protocols, emergency response plans, and regular risk assessments.● Promote environmental sustainability through energy efficiency and waste managementinitiatives.● All candidates must hold a valid HSE certification and demonstrate practical HSEimplementation experience.Cost and Budget Management● Prepare and manage the regional facilities budget, tracking all expenses.● Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or safety.● Provide monthly reports on expenditures, project costs, and budget performance.Employee and Workspace Support● Recommend and deliver workspace improvements that enhance employee productivityand satisfaction.● Oversee procurement and maintenance of office furniture, utilities, and equipment.● Ensure clean, safe, and conducive environments through effective janitorial and utilityservices.Continuous Improvement and Reporting● Gather feedback to assess the effectiveness of facilities services and identifyimprovement opportunities.● Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance, cost control, andspace management.● Maintain clear and consistent communication with stakeholders to align infrastructureplans with organizational goals. QualificationsExperience● Minimum of 7 years’ experience in facilities management, infrastructure development,and project execution.● Proven record of managing end-to-end facility projects across multiple locations.● Strong background in space planning and architectural design, including 2D/3Ddrawings.Education● Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.Skills● Proficiency in design and visualization software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, etc.).● Strong project management and coordination capabilities.● Solid knowledge of HSE and regulatory requirements.● Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills.● Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure.Certifications● Valid HSE certification (e.g., NEBOSH, OSHA, ISO 45001) is mandatory.● Project management certifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are a strong advantage.● Membership in a professional body (e.g., IFMA, ARCON) is a plus. Why Join Moniepoint?At Moniepoint, we’re building a team of world-class professionals dedicated to deliveringfinancial happiness across Africa. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape theoperational and physical infrastructure of one of Africa’s fastest-growing fintech companies.You’ll be part of a team that values ownership, execution, and innovation, making a realimpact as we scale.

title: Regional Field Sales Manager (North Central)
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. About Moniebook The all-in-one business management software for retail and restaurant businesses. We sell, track inventory, manage bookkeeping, and accept payments — all from one platform. Offline-first, mobile-ready, and built for how Nigerian businesses actually operate. For more info: https://moniepoint.com/moniebook Job Title: Regional Sales Coordinator Reports to: Head, Customer Acquisition Location: FCT Abuja (Field) About this role The Regional Sales Coordinator drives acquisition and conversion performance across assigned regions by recruiting, managing, coaching, and supporting a team of Field Sales Agents (FSAs). You will serve as the operational hub of the regional field sales function, owning agent recruitment pipelines, ensuring consistent field activity, and delivering against regional acquisition targets. This is a hands-on, frontline role that combines team building with active performance management and structured field support. Responsibilities Team Leadership & Coaching Lead & Develop: Manage a team of Field Sales Agents across assigned states, providing daily direction, motivation, and performance support. Coach: Conduct regular meetings, field ride-alongs, and coaching sessions to develop FSAs' product knowledge, objection handling, and acquisition skills. Onboard: Onboard new Field Sales Agents and ensure they are fully ramped and hitting activity targets within their first 30 days. Performance Management: Identify frontline skill gaps and run targeted coaching interventions to address them quickly. FSA Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Recruit: Own the end-to-end recruitment pipeline for Field Sales Agents in your region, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and recommending candidates for hire. Pipeline Building: Maintain a live talent bench by proactively building relationships with potential FSA candidates in your states, ensuring the region is never understaffed. Workforce Planning: Partner with the Operations team to forecast FSA headcount needs based on regional acquisition targets and attrition trends. Recruitment Reporting: Track time-to-fill and onboarding completion rates, flagging recruitment blockers to leadership in a timely manner. Sales Operations & Performance Drive Targets: Own region-level acquisition targets (weekly and monthly) and ensure individual FSAs meet their assigned quotas. Track Activity: Monitor daily field activity metrics, visits completed, leads generated, acquisitions recorded, and follow-ups made, and intervene when performance trends downward. Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed. Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis. Process & Quality Assurance Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines. Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions. Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams. Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers. Experience & Background 4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management. At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity. Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role. Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas. Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred. Skills & Competencies Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast. Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like. Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth. Data-Informed & People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage. Agility & Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly. Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities. Communication & Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows. What success looks like in this role Weeks 1–2: Complete full product and playbook onboarding. Shadow all FSAs in the field. Establish cadences with team members. Audit the existing FSA recruitment pipeline and playbook. Weeks 3–4: Run first structured field review sessions. Identify any headcount gaps and initiate active FSA recruitment in understaffed states. Month 2: Fully own regional KPI tracking on a weekly basis. Fill open FSA roles and ensure all new hires are progressing through onboarding on schedule. Month 3: Region achieves 85%–100% of the monthly acquisition quota. FSAs have active coaching plans in place, and the recruitment pipeline remains healthy. Why join us Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities. Dynamic field support structures and tools built to facilitate high-performance execution. Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech brand driving financial inclusion.

title: Regional Marketing Specialist, NE
description: Who we are  Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role The Regional Marketing Specialist is a strategic bridge between central brand directives and local market execution. You will be responsible for driving brand dominance and customer acquisition within your assigned region. By leveraging localized insights, you will ensure Moniepoint is the first choice for consumers and that our physical and digital presence translates into measurable growth in market share and accounts opened. What you will do Strategic Planning & Budgeting Campaign Planning: Develop quarterly regional marketing calendars aligned with the bank’s national strategy but tailored to local cultural/economic nuances. Financial Oversight: Manage the regional marketing budget; perform monthly reconciliations and ensure all vendors are onboarded and paid per procurement policy. ROI Analysis: Track the "Cost Per Acquisition" (CPA) for all regional activities to ensure high-impact spending. Local Brand & Identity Management Branding Implementation: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for the region, ensuring all branches, ATMs, and signage meet corporate visual identity standards. Local Media Buying: Identify and manage high-impact local visibility opportunities (e.g., regional radio, billboards in high-traffic markets, or community sponsorships). Competitor Intelligence: Monitor local competitor moves and provide monthly reports on their pricing, visibility, and tactics. Sales Support & Market Activations Neighborhood Activations: Design and execute high-energy "storming" exercises in key markets, transport hubs, and residential clusters to generate immediate leads. Sales Enablement: Provide the regional sales team with the necessary collateral (flyers, branded merchandise, and digital assets) to close leads effectively. Community & Relationship Marketing (Added Duties) Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with local traditional rulers, trade unions, and community leaders to facilitate "entry" into new market segments. Customer Feedback Loop: Conduct informal focus groups or surveys during activations to gather insights on local pain points and product gaps. CSR Coordination: Identify local charitable or community causes that align with the bank’s values to boost regional goodwill. Who you are  Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: 4–6 years of progressive marketing experience, ideally within the Financial Services, FMCG, or Telecommunications sectors. Key Skills & Competencies Data Analysis: Proficient in analyzing market data and performance metrics to derive actionable insights and inform decision-making. Event & Project Management: Proven track record in planning, coordinating, and executing large-scale events and marketing activations end-to-end. Vendor Management & Negotiation: Exceptional negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to build strong vendor relationships and secure optimal contract terms. What success looks like Top of Mind Awareness (TOMA): Increasing the percentage of consumers in the region who name our bank first when asked about financial services. State Penetration Ratio: Growing the bank’s market share within specific districts compared to total addressable population. Cards Sold: Direct impact on the volume of new accounts opened via regional sales initiatives and marketing led activations. Budget Efficiency: Maintaining a variance of less than 5% between planned and reconciled campaign spend.

title: Regional Security Lead (North East)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry. By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them. Key Responsibilities Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region. Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk. Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect. Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies. Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve. Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols. Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient. Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery. Qualifications Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO. Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential. Language & Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community. Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc. About You You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough. You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team. You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.  You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About This Role We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (Design System) who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces.In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code. Responsibilities UI Craft & Visual Excellence: Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements. Component Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products. Interaction & Motion Design: Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive. Design Token Management: Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code. Figma Library Architecture: Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately. Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments. Documentation & Governance: Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used. Experience & Background Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features. Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android. Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows. Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories. Skills & Competencies Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication. Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles. Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology. Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines. What Success Looks Like in This Role High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles. Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS). Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance. Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction. Why Join Us Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description: About us Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role As a Senior UX researcher, you’ll be the voice of our users. You’ll play a critical role in shaping our product strategy by uncovering deep insights into the needs, behaviours, and aspirations of our users—especially within Nigeria. We’re on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, and your research will directly influence how we design products that are accessible, intuitive, and impactful. You’ll collaborate closely with our creators to ensure our solutions are grounded in real-world market realities. Key responsibilities Lead and execute end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research across the product lifecycle—from discovery to delivery. Use a range of methods including in-depth interviews, ethnographic studies, usability testing, surveys, and diary studies, with a focus on the Nigerian context. Synthesise complex data into actionable insights and frameworks (personas, journey maps, mental models) that drive empathy across the team. Stay ahead of fintech and consumer trends in Nigeria and comparable markets through continuous landscape analysis.
